before.title_zh: 对齐与治理中的未来条件
before.title_en: Conditions of a future in alignment and governance
before.claim_zh: 对齐须连接理解、关切、实际权能、纠正与更新，使行动对受影响生活及后续条件负责。
before.claim_en: Alignment must connect understanding, concern, effective power, correction and renewal so that action answers to affected lives and their future conditions.
before.scope_zh: 候选原则、条件机制与限定经验接口；完整对齐治理及比较优势尚未确立。
before.scope_en: Candidate principle, conditional mechanisms and bounded empirical interfaces; complete alignment/governance and comparative advantage remain unestablished.

before.connection_zh: 将整条共同形成链用于 AI 与制度，而不把单项任务成功当成整体对齐。
before.connection_en: Applies the full co-formation chain to AI and institutions rather than equating local task success with alignment.
before.source_section: The conditions of a future in AI alignment and governance

after.title_zh: AI 对齐方向的明确根据
after.title_en: Explicit grounding of an AI alignment direction
after.claim_zh: G0 与公开 J1–J4 支持实际生与进一步共同生成，规定有范围的增长比较、有界责任、有效纠正、交接及结束；构造 AI 案例保留新能力的真实增益与放弃损失。
after.claim_en: G0 with disclosed J1–J4 supports actual living and further shared generation through scoped growth comparisons, bounded responsibility, effective correction, transfer and ending; a constructed AI case retains real capability gains and forgone benefits.
after.scope_zh: 方向论证已完成并获独立接受；9项新定理／16项新审计，加46项继承审计，独立重编译通过。无公理根据、部署可靠性和比较优势各有独立范围。
after.scope_en: Direction argument complete and independently accepted; 9 new theorems/16 new audits plus 46 inherited audits pass independent recompilation. Axiom-free grounding, reliable deployment and comparative advantage retain separate scopes.
